Where we operate

Headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia.

Couch Disposal Plus is operated by LoadUp Technologies, LLC, headquartered in metro Atlanta. The platform operates a nationwide network of independent local Loaders performing residential pickups across 50 states — but the company itself is run from Georgia.

The address below is the corporate office for business correspondence. Customer pickups happen at the customer's home address, not the office. For pickup-related questions, call (844) 311-0204 or use the contact paths above.
